data.name: Jawairia
data.gender_notes: Jawairia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root letters J-W-R, which in Arabic means to 'glorify' or 'praise'. In Islamic context, it can signify the one who is glorified and praised, or it can be a name for a girl who is praised and glorified herself. It's a beautiful name with a rich meaning rooted in Islamic tradition. The name Jawairia carries the meaning “Glorified, Praised One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawairia usually hope their child will grow to embody glorified, praised one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the praise and glorification of Allah.
data.etymology: Jawairia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorified, Praised One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawairia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
